questions.title: Pair Sum Indices
questions.prompt: Given a list of integers and a target, return the indices of two different elements whose values add to the target. Exactly one valid pair exists.
questions.solution_outline: Scan once while mapping previously seen values to indices; look up target minus the current value.

questions.title: Contains a Repeated Value
questions.prompt: Return true when any integer occurs more than once in the list; otherwise return false.
questions.solution_outline: Track seen values in a set and stop at the first repeat.

questions.title: Maximum Contiguous Sum
questions.prompt: Return the largest sum obtainable from a non-empty contiguous segment of the integer list.
constraints: The chosen segment must be non-empty
questions.solution_outline: Maintain the best sum ending at each position and the best sum seen overall.

questions.title: Longest Distinct Window
questions.prompt: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring containing no repeated character.
questions.solution_outline: Move a left boundary past the previous occurrence of each character while scanning once.

questions.title: Balanced Delimiters
questions.prompt: A string contains only (), [] and {} characters. Return true when every opening delimiter is closed in the correct order.
questions.solution_outline: Push opening delimiters and require each closer to match the latest opener.

questions.title: Next Warmer Distance
questions.prompt: For each daily temperature, return how many days must pass before a strictly warmer temperature. Use zero when none exists.
questions.solution_outline: Keep indices in a decreasing stack and resolve them when a warmer value appears.

questions.title: First Position in Sorted Data
questions.prompt: Given a non-decreasing integer list, return the first index containing the target, or -1 when the target is absent.
constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
questions.solution_outline: Use lower-bound binary search, then verify the resulting position.

questions.title: Merge Sorted Values
questions.prompt: Merge two non-decreasing integer lists into one non-decreasing list containing every input value.
questions.solution_outline: Advance two pointers, repeatedly taking the smaller current value, then append leftovers.

questions.title: Level-Order Tree Height
questions.prompt: A binary tree is encoded in level order using null for missing nodes. Return its height measured in nodes; an empty tree has height zero.
questions.solution_outline: Traverse valid level-order positions and track the deepest reachable node.
questions.reference_solution:
def tree_height(values):
    if not values or values[0] is None:
        return 0
    best = 0
    queue = [(0, 1)]
    head = 0
    while head < len(queue):
        index, depth = queue[head]; head += 1
        if index >= len(values) or values[index] is None:
            continue
        best = max(best, depth)
        queue.append((2 * index + 1, depth + 1))
        queue.append((2 * index + 2, depth + 1))
    return best

questions.title: Unweighted Graph Distances
questions.prompt: Given a node count, undirected edges, and a start node, return the minimum number of edges from the start to every node. Use -1 for unreachable nodes.
questions.solution_outline: Build adjacency lists and perform breadth-first search from the start node.
